title: Greg Abel Bought $39.4 Billion of Stocks in 6 Months, Up From the $7.1 Billion Berkshire Purchased a Year Earlier Under Warren Buffett
author: Neil Patel
description: Berkshire Hathaway shifted to net stock buying in Q2 2026 under CEO Greg Abel, purchasing $39.4 billion in equities during the first half of the year compared to $7.1 billion a year earlier. The company's most notable addition was Alphabet, making it the third-largest portfolio position. Despite a frothy market with elevated valuations, Abel is playing offense while managing $365.5 billion in cash and Treasuries awaiting deployment.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Shifted from net seller to aggressive net buyer of stocks, purchasing $39.4B in H1 2026 vs $7.1B year-over-year, indicating renewed confidence in equity markets and active capital deployment under new CEO leadership.

title: Is Tesla About to Finally Launch the Robotaxi Fleet That Will Justify Its Valuation?
author: Patrick Sanders
description: Tesla is holding a major event in Austin to unveil details about its Cybercab, a driverless two-seat vehicle designed to operate unsupervised using Full Self-Driving technology. The event is critical for Tesla's stock momentum, as Morgan Stanley analysts warn that a meaningful increase in unsupervised vehicles could be a catalyst for outperformance, while an underwhelming announcement could result in a muted or negative market reaction. Tesla stock is down 15% year-to-date and faces pressure from declining margins and rising expenses.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Tesla faces a pivotal moment with the Cybercab event that could significantly impact its stock trajectory. While the company has made progress with FSD technology (14.1 billion miles driven, 7x lower collision rates), it still lags behind Waymo in commercial robotaxi deployment. Recent earnings showed declining margins (1.4% vs 4.1% YoY) and rising expenses, offsetting strong revenue growth. The stock's 7% pre-event rally reflects optimism, but success is uncertain and highly dependent on announcement details.

Waymo is positioned as a competitive leader in autonomous vehicles with commercial robotaxi services operating in 14 U.S. cities and a fleet of 4,000 driverless vehicles. The article highlights that Tesla has fallen behind Waymo, suggesting Waymo's current market advantage in the autonomous vehicle space.

title: New Measurement Data: AI Engines Disagree by 2× on Which Brands to Recommend, Treyci Analysis Finds
author: Not Specified
description: Treyci's analysis of over 1,200 AI-generated answers reveals major discrepancies in how different AI engines mention and recommend brands, with visibility gaps as wide as 81% versus 43% across engines. The study shows AI responses are probabilistic and inconsistent, with engines citing third-party review platforms rather than vendor websites, highlighting that most companies lack proper measurement of their AI visibility efforts.
